# Native provider and policy

This package uses the public MIT `@trycua/cua-driver` SDK **0.28.2** and the matching official macOS universal daemon. It contains no Codex source, executable, asset or private API. The daemon is prepared by `node scripts/prepare-computer-use-native.mjs`; the exact official archive SHA-256 and extracted executable SHA-256 are recorded in `manifest.json` and verified again by the default adapter before startup. The binary must remain outside ASAR with its executable bit preserved and be signed as part of any signed enclosing application.

The daemon starts only after the first native query and a read-only check of the actual importing host's Accessibility and Screen Recording grants. The adapter never requests system permission dialogs, installs services, changes TCC or enables automatic approval. `hostBundleId` labels the trusted host namespace; it does not create or transfer macOS permissions. A caller-supplied `binaryPath` is an explicit trusted-host override; packaged production uses the receipt-verified daemon.

Every host is configured with standard permission mode and all approval/bypass flags false. Input uses an exact PID, native window, current snapshot and observed element token/index, with explicit background delivery. Unavailable background delivery is returned as unsupported, with no automatic foreground escalation or replay. Cancellation stops this owned daemon and drains its request before releasing SDK handles; a dispatched write has an unknown outcome. It cannot cancel another installed driver.

Telemetry is explicitly disabled in the child with both `CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false` and `CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false`. The 0.28.2 public embedded-host environment allowlist supports these names. The adapter never invokes update, install, autostart or a newer release; updates require a reviewed version/checksum change and a new plugin build. **This pinned SDK does not permit `CUA_DRIVER_RS_UPDATE_CHECK` in embedded environment overrides, so the adapter does not claim to disable the daemon's upstream background update check.** It does not pass an unsupported variable or mutate the host's global environment to evade that limitation.

Sources: [tagged embedded host](https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.28.2/libs/cua-driver/rust/crates/cua-driver-sdk/src/embedded.rs), [tagged telemetry](https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.28.2/libs/cua-driver/rust/crates/cua-driver/src/telemetry.rs), [official pinned release](https://github.com/trycua/cua/releases/tag/cua-driver-rs-v0.28.2).

SDK limitations are exposed instead of filled in: no producer image timestamp or atomic AX/image guarantee; no native AX identifier, focused-element flag or complete secure-field subrole in this contract; raw AX bounds have no documented screenshot transform and are omitted. Only exposed secure/password role/label patterns are rejected, so this is not a complete password-field detector. Web-content AX values are withheld from input-readback evidence. Pixels are accepted only against a validated same-window image frame. The core package does not include optional perception/browser extensions.

The driver license is preserved in `LICENSE-cua-driver.txt`. The SDK's platform package carries its own copy-mode N-API runtime notice; it remains part of the public dependency closure rather than being copied into this plugin.
